about: Get started's firmware picker (site/guide.js): each way in and exploit with the firmwares it runs on, and the HEN for each firmware. site/guide.py checks every page and heading named here. The scene moves fast: change this file and get-started.md's table together, and the date with them.

ways.name: the web browser
ways.needs: Nothing extra: no disc, no USB drive, nothing erased.

ways.name: a Blu-ray disc
ways.needs: A disc drive, a computer with a Blu-ray burner, and a blank BD-R or BD-RE.

ways.name: the YouTube app
ways.needs: The YouTube app at an old version, from a backup on a USB drive.
ways.caution: Getting the old YouTube app onto a PS5 that isn't jailbroken yet means restoring a backup from USB, which erases the console. Back up your saves first.

hens.name: etaHEN
hens.why: It covers firmwares up to 12.70, and it's the HEN Playtendoh is tested with most.
hens.letIn: Add `PPSA99360` to etaHEN's app jailbreak list, and turn its app jailbreak on.

hens.name: Kstuff Lite
hens.why: etaHEN stops at 12.70; Kstuff Lite reaches 13.60.
hens.letIn: Nothing to add. Keep an ELF loader running on port 9021: Playtendoh opens `/data` through it.

notes.text: On 13.xx some HENs open `/data` but not USB drives. Playtendoh opens them through the ELF loader on port 9021, so keep one running if your games are on a drive.
